Prenatal Massage

Therapeutic support
for every stage
of pregnancy.

Prenatal massage is a therapeutic and soothing treatment that's safe and supportive for the mother-to-be. Geared to nurture and alleviate the discomforts unique to pregnancy — shifting posture, round ligament tension, swollen ankles, upper back strain — while honoring the changes your body is moving through.

All products used are free from any ingredients that could put you or your baby at risk.
